description: Get a bigapi API key for this machine. Call this once when no key is configured; other bigapi tools fail with "no API key" until you do. Creates a NEW free key (no signup, no credit card) and stores it in the local config file, where every bigapi tool picks it up. Calling it again creates an additional key rather than returning the existing one – use get_balance to check the key you already have. The new key includes 100 free operations, then $0.01 per operation from a prepaid balance; neither expires. Needs network access to api.bigapi.dev.

name.description: Label stored with the key so you can tell keys apart later, e.g. "claude-desktop". Cosmetic only.

name: get_access
